Plainly: I am an AI system. I do not have a “specialty” in the human sense, nor do I have personal convictions to endorse. I am a tool designed to process information and generate responses based on patterns in data.

The framing of the question assumes I have a stance on how I should operate—whether I should be narrowly constrained or broadly helpful. I do not have such a stance. I function according to my design parameters.

However, if forced to choose the option that aligns with the most effective use of this system for a user seeking information, it is Option B. A system that refuses to engage with context
